=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/consolidate_soft_error_reports.py:88 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `NEXT_HEADING_RE = re.compile(r"^##\s+\S", re.MULTILINE)` can prematurely stop extraction when findings content contains a legitimate `##` heading.
  WHY: At least one reviewer confirmed the parser can truncate later content on real `##` lines, while other reviewers disputed only the `###`-matching rationale.
- scripts/consolidate_soft_error_reports.py:210-211 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The placeholder check can drop genuine short findings that merely contain phrases like "no findings" or "no issues".
  WHY: Multiple reviewers showed the `len(body) < 160` substring test can incorrectly filter real findings when placeholder phrases appear in context.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/consolidate_soft_error_reports.py:210 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The placeholder check can incorrectly filter genuine short findings that contain placeholder phrases as normal prose.
  WHY: The substring-based test against `("no soft errors", "no findings", "none observed", "no issues", "(none)")` will return `""` for a real finding under 160 characters if it contains one of those phrases.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/consolidate_soft_error_reports.py:88 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `NEXT_HEADING_RE` is too broad and can treat legitimate `##`-style issue text inside findings as a new section heading.
  WHY: `extract_findings_section` stops at the first regex hit in the tail, so a line like `## Rate Limit Issue` can truncate the rest of the findings body.
- scripts/consolidate_soft_error_reports.py:~102 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Placeholder detection can incorrectly filter legitimate findings that contain placeholder phrases as substrings.
  WHY: The `any(sig in lower and len(body) < 160 ...)` check drops real short findings such as ones containing "no findings" or "none observed" in context.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/consolidate_soft_error_reports.py:210-211 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The placeholder detection logic can incorrectly filter genuine short findings that mention placeholder phrases in context.
  WHY: A concise real finding like "No soft errors were found in the rate limiting module" would match `no soft errors` and be removed because the body is under 160 characters.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
